name: seismic_display
title: GEOX Seismic Display Conventions
citation: GEOX Seismic Interpretation Forge Package; Morley et al. 2023 (Geosphere v19 no.1)
description: Display conventions for seismic section images and horizons. Drives geox_seismic_render_publication.v1 dash styles, line widths, label fonts, and color palette. This is the SEISMIC-DISPLAY-ONLY resource — it carries NO amplitude, attribute, or AVO interpretation. Claim ceiling: GEOMETRY.

horizon.sru.label: SRU
horizon.sru.semantic: Shallow Regional Unconformity (~8.5–9 Ma, NW Sabah)

horizon.uiu.label: UIU
horizon.uiu.semantic: Upper Intra-IVC Unconformity (~10.5–11 Ma, base IVC / top mini-basin fill)

horizon.dru.label: DRU
horizon.dru.semantic: Deep Regional Unconformity (~12–13 Ma, base mini-basin)

horizon.uncertain.label: uncertain
horizon.uncertain.semantic: Hypothesis horizon; not pinned to canonical stage

geobody.mobile_shale.semantic: NSPW mobile shale / diapir body (geometry only)

notes: Display-proxy resource. Claim ceiling = GEOMETRY only. Any request to derive amplitudes, attributes, AVO, or quantitative decisions from a rendered image is REFUSED at the tool layer (evidence_class enforcement).
